name: INNIO Jenbacher J920 FleXtra gas engine
description: Vendor product line read 2026-11-24. Deployed in the 104 MW Greenville, Texas peaking plant with 11 engines (POWER article, page_read:true). Primary source: https://powermag.com/engine-power-plants-surge-as-data-centers-drive-unprecedented-demand/

specifications.basis: POWER magazine article: 'achieves full load within two minutes'

specifications.metric: Engine portfolio rating (Jenbacher Type 9 page navigation)

'INNIO Group announced ... a 2.3 GW power infrastructure project with VoltaGrid featuring 92 power packs, each delivering 25 MW of output.'
specifications.value: 2.3 GW, 92 power packs each delivering 25 MW

specifications.basis: 'maintains full power and efficiency even at ambient temperatures up to 122F (50C)'.
'INNIO's Jenbacher J920 FleXtra engine, the largest in the company's gas engine portfolio, achieves full load within two minutes.'
POWER article, 'Fast-Start Technology Becomes Standard Requirement' section.
specifications.value: 104 MW, 11 engines, >17,200 customers; groundbreaking Dec 2025, commissioning summer 2027

specifications.basis: 'The 450-MW flexible generation facility ... expected to achieve full operations by late 2026 ... rapid start-up in less than five minutes ... Ready for H2'. Conflicting start times vs J920 2 minutes preserved as printed.
specifications.value: 450 MW; Jenbacher engines start in less than five minutes; 'Ready for H2'

specifications.basis: 'up to 95% lower nitrogen oxide emissions' for the KMW (Kraftwerke Mainz-Wiesbaden AG) energy systems.
